items.title: BoF organisation hub tracks Kering Q3 outlook and Gucci turnaround pace
items.summary: BoF's running Gucci coverage hub frames Q3 2026 as the pivotal proof point for the turnaround: after Q2 comparable sales narrowed to a 2 percent decline (beating the roughly 3.3 percent consensus), management under CEO Luca de Meo guided to flat group growth for Q3, with Gucci's Demna-led autumn collections needing to confirm the sequential improvement is durable rather than a one-quarter blip.

items.title: Puck newsletter dissects Gucci executive-power dynamics post-Cantino exit
items.summary: Puck's fashion-business newsletter examines the internal reshuffle at Gucci and Kering following Stefano Cantino's April departure to Dolce & Gabbana, arguing Luca de Meo is centralizing turnaround authority around Demna and a leaner leadership bench; opinion-inflected trade coverage, corroborated here against WWD/BoF financial reporting per source-pool policy.

items.title: Palazzo Gucci's Demna-led "Gucci Storia" heritage project draws continued Florence coverage
items.summary: WWD continues to cover Palazzo Gucci in Florence, reopened under Demna as a cultural destination featuring the "Gucci Storia" exhibition (heritage tapestries, campaign archive gallery, craftsmanship room and an interactive digital installation), positioned by the house as part of rebuilding brand desirability beyond pure product drops ahead of the September Milan show season.

items.title: Milan Fashion Week SS27 calendar confirms Demna's second Gucci runway show, September 22-28
items.summary: Trade coverage of the confirmed Milan Fashion Week Spring/Summer 2027 women's calendar (September 22-28) lists Gucci among the marquee shows, marking Demna's second collection presentation since his 2025 appointment; positioned by press as a key test of whether his codes are landing commercially after the Q2 sales-decline narrowing.

items.title: Trustpilot reviewers continue to flag defective goods and denied warranty claims
items.summary: Recent 1-star reviews on Gucci's Trustpilot page (UK and US customers, week of Aug 27-28) describe crazed sunglass lenses denied warranty repair, a canceled tie order despite processed payment, and suspicious delivery-confirmation emails; site-wide TrustScore remains 1.8/5 across roughly 1,729 reviews, with quality control and customer service the dominant complaint themes -- a recurring, low-visibility but persistent negative signal.

items.title: PurseForum Gucci subforum discussion continues on resale value gap versus LV/Chanel
items.summary: Long-running PurseForum thread asking why Gucci bags command lower resale value than Louis Vuitton or Chanel remains active; regular posters attribute the gap to logo saturation from the Michele era, perceived hardware/canvas quality inconsistency, and frequent past creative-director changes eroding buyer confidence in long-term collectibility, even as some note renewed interest in Demna-era archive-referencing pieces.

items.title: Gucci official Instagram Cruise 2026 carousel continues to circulate
items.summary: Gucci's brand-owned Instagram account continues posting Cruise 2026 and archival campaign carousels into early September; treated as brand-controlled activation per sentiment-rubric discount rather than independent public opinion, included for Buzz-channel completeness only. Post-level like/comment counts were not visible without authenticated platform access.

items.title: Retail-investor analysis: "the Gucci reset is becoming an earnings recovery"
items.summary: Investor-community contributor piece argues Kering's operational leverage (cost cuts, inventory rationalization, store-productivity focus) is starting to outpace consensus earnings expectations, citing improved H1 2026 free cash flow of roughly EUR1.8bn and narrower net debt, while cautioning that mainland China traffic and Gucci comparable sales remain the key unresolved risk into Q3.

items.title: German financial wire: Kering stock holds steady as investors digest H1 2026 reset
items.summary: German-market financial news wire reports Kering shares trading in a narrow range on Euronext Paris as investors weigh the H1 2026 turnaround package against continued softness in mainland China, where Gucci, Bottega Veneta and Balenciaga all posted double-digit declines in the latest reported period -- a note of caution counterbalancing the more upbeat post-Q2 rally coverage.
